projects.title: AI-Powered Natural Language Data Assistant
projects.description: Designed and built a production NL-to-SQL system enabling natural-language querying over millions of healthcare claims. The system investigates key research challenges: semantic parsing accuracy for complex analytical queries, zero-data-leakage security guarantees in multi-tenant SQL generation, and sub-second query optimization for real-time analytics. Deployed at Therap (BD) Ltd., serving thousands of healthcare providers across the United States.
features: Investigated reliability of LLM-generated SQL queries in a production multi-tenant healthcare system
Designed a zero-data-leakage SQL security model enforcing strict tenant isolation under adversarial natural-language inputs
Engineered sub-second analytical query execution over datasets spanning millions of healthcare claims

projects.title: Context-Aware AI Development Workflow (MCP)
projects.description: Engineered a context engineering pipeline connecting AI coding assistants to a structured code knowledge base via Model Context Protocol (MCP). This project explores how structured context management and retrieval-augmented generation can improve AI agent reliability in software development. Achieved a 40% reduction in development time on a large-scale legacy monolith.
features: Designed and evaluated context engineering strategies for AI-assisted software development on legacy codebases
Explored the architectural implications of MCP as a protocol for human-AI collaborative development workflows
Demonstrated 40% reduction in development time through improved context retrieval and agent grounding

projects.title: LLM-Powered Automated Code Documentation System
projects.description: Built a full-stack automated program comprehension pipeline that generates wiki-style documentation from source code using large language models. Investigates the challenge of maintaining accurate, up-to-date documentation through incremental change detection and semantic embedding-based search.
features: Developed an LLM-powered documentation generation pipeline with incremental change detection for large codebases
Integrated vector embeddings (Oracle 26ai) for semantic search across auto-generated documentation
Built a browser-based wiki interface for navigating generated documentation articles

projects.title: Autonomous Maze Exploration and Shortest-Path Navigation Robot
projects.description: Designed and implemented an Arduino-based intelligent assistant robot capable of autonomous maze exploration and shortest-path navigation. The system combines backtracking-based maze traversal with BFS/dynamic programming for optimal path computation, demonstrating algorithmic problem-solving in a physical robotics context.
features: Designed a backtracking-based maze exploration algorithm for autonomous robotic navigation
Implemented BFS and dynamic programming optimization for shortest-path computation
Built a real-time navigation simulation and visualization interface using C# and Unity

projects.title: Open-Source Contributions
projects.description: Active contributor to open-source projects in the Java ecosystem. Contributed to stablyai/orca and java-design-patterns, and created the orca repository. These contributions demonstrate engagement with the broader software engineering community and collaborative development practices.
features: Contributed to stablyai/orca - an open-source project in the AI/ML ecosystem
Contributed to iluwatar/java-design-patterns - a widely-used educational resource for software design patterns
Created and maintained the orca repository for independent exploration and experimentation
